title: Workbench terminal case result
description: One case attempt from the owner-scoped get_run response. A new request has a new run ID and starts at attempt one. A replay of the request returns the same attempt.

exit_code.description: Assertion outcome: 0 for passed, 1 for failed, null when unavailable.

worker_exit_code.description: Observed process return code, negative for signals on POSIX, or null when unavailable.

duration_ms.description: Elapsed time from worker claim to terminal record. Zero for an unclaimed run.

version.description: Observed Python or Node runtime version. Null when the historical run or stopped worker supplied no version.

evidence.description: Suite-specific sanitized observations and authenticated screenshot or trace URLs, where available.
